summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py (thread-entry state initialised in __init__, set and cleared in the run entry point's try/finally, invoke-based scheduling via run_coroutine_threadsafe) and added tests/test_call_from_thread.py with nine tests. All nine pass on the recorded venv when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src, since the venv's textual install points at base/. Some unrelated existing async tests fail in this environment because no async pytest plugin is configured; I did not verify whether they fail on the unmodified tree. Nothing is committed.
